name: Blouin & Steel Fabricators
old_description: We provide complete structural steel fabrication services based out of Northfield, NH.
about:
Blouin Steel Fabricators, Inc. operates from Northfield, New Hampshire, where it has provided structural steel fabrication services since 1995. The company was founded that year and has since built a reputation for handling complete structural steel projects.

The shop fabricates primary structural members as well as miscellaneous items such as stairways, safety bollards, and steel concrete embeds. It also offers custom metal fabrication, miscellaneous steel stair fabrication, and in-house erection crews to complete installations. Steel sales round out the offering for construction and manufacturing needs.

The company serves commercial, residential, and municipal clients. Commercial projects include schools, hospitals, banks, lumber yards, pharmacies, and apartment buildings. Residential work covers renovations, upgrades, repairs, and steel supply. Municipal contracts involve waste water facilities, water treatment plants, and ponds for water management.

Blouin Steel emphasizes meticulous attention to detail on every product, regardless of size, and states that its focus is entirely on client needs and satisfaction. The firm positions itself as a creator of reliable solutions tailored to each project’s requirements.
